C0369.title: CISA Alert: Cyber Attackers Targeting U.S. Organizations with Password Spraying
C0369.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) issued an alert warning that malicious cyber actors are increasingly using password spraying, a variant of brute-force credential attacks, against U.S. and overseas organizations. This technique attempts a small set of common passwords against many accounts to evade account lockout policies.
